 purchase  Log in, buy one item, and read the confirmation.
   log_in › open_item › add_current_item_to_cart › go_to_cart › go_to_checkout › fill_checkout_info › place_order › read_confirmation

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 Cart  /cart.html
   continue_shopping         Return from Cart to Inventory without checking out.
   go_to_checkout            Proceed from the cart to checkout.
   read_cart                 List the cart's current line items by name.
   remove_from_cart          Remove a line item from the cart by name.
 CheckoutInfo  /checkout-step-one.html
   fill_checkout_info        Fill the first checkout step and continue to the order review.
   read_checkout_error       Read the checkout-info error banner, if any.
 CheckoutOverview  /checkout-step-two.html
   place_order               Submit the order from the review step.
 Complete  /checkout-complete.html
   read_confirmation         Read the confirmation heading ("Thank you for your order!").
 Inventory  /inventory.html
   open_item                 Open a product's detail page by name, from the Inventory list.
   add_to_cart               Add a product to the cart by name, from the Inventory list.
 Item  /inventory-item.html
   back_to_products          Return from an item's detail page to Inventory.
   add_current_item_to_cart  Add the currently-open item (Item detail page) to the cart.
 Login  /
   log_in                    Log in from the Login page. saucedemo's published test users are all valid usernames (standard_user, locked_out_user, problem_user,…
   read_login_error          Read the login error banner, if any (e.g. after log_in with locked_out_user).
 (any view)
   log_out                   Log out via the sidebar menu, back to Login.
   go_to_cart                Navigate to the cart from anywhere via the nav-bar cart link.
